newsitem.title: UK: BAT off, NatWest previews upcoming results.
newsitem.headline: BAT off, NatWest previews upcoming results.

text.p: Shares in B.A.T Industries Plc eased 7-1/2p to 530p in a strong market on Friday with dealers noting NatWest Securities released a downbeat results preview on the cigarette to insurance group.
First half results are due on July 30.
"The results preview is negative on trading but not necessarily on litigation," said one analyst, referring to ongoing tobacco lawsuits in the U.S.
"There doesn't seem to be anything particularly portentous in the news overnight. Philip Morris slipped two percent with some big trades going through but not on any news," he said.
Philip Morris shares fell $1-5/32 last night to $42.
Nearly five million B.A.T shares traded, making it the third most active stock in the London market by 0903 GMT.
